title: Paper accepted to IEEE S&P 2026
summary: Our paper on the usability of anonymity features in period and fertility tracking apps was accepted to the 47th IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy.
details: Usable Anonymity in Reproductive Health Privacy — Qiurong Song, Yanlai Wu, Rie Helene (Lindy) Hernandez, Yao Li, Yubo Kou, and Xinning Gui
